relations.subject: version:cbl-4-0
relations.evidence: Couchbase Lite 4.x is only compatible with Sync Gateway 4.0 and later. Connecting Couchbase Lite 4.x to Sync Gateway versions before 4.0 is not supported due to version vector architecture changes.

relations.subject: sgw:bidirectional-xdcr
relations.evidence: Sync Gateway 4.0 and later requires CBS 7.6.1+. Active-Active XDCR requires CBS 7.6.5+. Sync Gateway 3.x does not support Active-Active XDCR.

relations.subject: version:sgw-4-0
relations.evidence: Sync Gateway 4.0 and later requires CBS 7.6.1+.

relations.subject: version:sgw-4-0

relations.subject: version:sgw-3-3-0

notable_absence.finding: The known-issue callout about Couchbase Server 6.0 (MB-41255) causing rebalance failures under shared-bucket-access with Xattrs is a real compatibility fact tied to a specific external bug tracker id, not a version. The ontology has no way to represent 'external bug tracker reference' as a first-class object - it can only be captured as prose in this finding field.

cross_component_finding: The Sync-Gateway/Couchbase-Server matrix and the Sync-Gateway/Couchbase-Lite matrix are maintained as two independently-versioned tables on the same page, and the version thresholds do not line up: Sync Gateway 4.0/4.1 requires Server 7.6.1+ but requires no CBL version increase at all (compatible with CBL 2.0+), while CBL 4.0 requires Sync Gateway 4.0+ specifically. Three independent version axes (SGW, Server, CBL) are gated against each other with different minimums on each pairing.
cross_product_finding: sgw:bidirectional-xdcr (this page's 'Bidirectional Active-Active XDCR' matrix row, minimum Server 7.6.5+) sits right next to the already-promoted xdcr:active-active-with-app-services (minimum Server 7.6.6+, App Services 4.0+) without either page cross-referencing the other's version floor - a one-patch-level (7.6.5 vs 7.6.6) discrepancy between the Sync-Gateway-facing and App-Services-facing documentation of what reads as the same underlying Server-side XDCR capability.
